headings.title: Attorney general representation and state defense costs
headings.reviewNote: Directs the attorney general to defend the oversight commission in legal actions, with the state responsible for costs and damages.

headings.title: Authorization of virtual and remote commission meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the oversight commission to conduct meetings and hearings in person or through video conference platforms.

headings.title: Finality and mandatory implementation of commission decisions
headings.reviewNote: Makes all commission appellate decisions final and requires activities associations to adhere to and implement all rulings.

headings.title: Department rulemaking and statutory administrative nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Subjects department procedural rules to chapter 536 administrative procedures and statutory nonseverability provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 10 subsection headings for 167.795 governing the Interscholastic Athletic Oversight Commission, student transfer appeals, and finality.

headings.title: Comprehensive training guidelines for diabetes care personnel
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required training elements for diabetes personnel, including glucose checks, insulin delivery, glucagon, and emergency protocols.

headings.title: Minimum trained employee requirements and volunteer recruitment
headings.reviewNote: Requires districts or charter schools adopting the guidelines to ensure training for at least three employees per school with a diabetic student and distribute a volunteer notice when fewer than three are available (source footnote notes 'insure' in original rolls).

headings.title: Protection against penalties for refusing diabetes training
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits disciplinary action or employment penalties against school staff who decline to volunteer as diabetes care personnel.

headings.title: Coordination and timing of diabetes training by nurses
headings.reviewNote: Requires adopting districts or charter schools to have training coordinated by a school nurse if available, provided by a nurse or diabetes health care professional before each school year or within thirty days of enrollment or diagnosis.

headings.title: Hypoglycemia and emergency training for staff and drivers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes training in recognizing hypoglycemia emergencies for teachers, staff, and bus drivers supervising diabetic students.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 167.803 governing school diabetes care personnel training guidelines, volunteers, and emergency instructions.

headings.title: Authorized diabetes care functions under medical plans
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes nurses and trained personnel to perform glucose checks, insulin administration, glucagon treatments, and meal monitoring.

headings.title: On-site availability of trained personnel during school events
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes trained personnel or nurses to be on site and available during school hours, trips, extracurricular activities, and buses.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 167.809 governing authorized diabetes care functions by school nurses or trained staff and on-site coverage.

headings.title: Exemption of authorized diabetes care from nursing practice
headings.reviewNote: Exempts authorized school diabetes care functions from statutory and regulatory nursing practice restrictions and delegation limits.

headings.title: Authority of healthcare professionals to train school staff
headings.reviewNote: Affirms legal authority of licensed healthcare professionals to train and supervise designated school personnel in diabetes care.

headings.title: Preservation of student rights under federal disability laws
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that diabetes care provisions do not exceed student rights or district obligations under IDEA, Section 504, or the ADA.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 167.812 governing exemptions from nursing practice limits and alignment with federal disability statutes.

headings.title: Department rules governing school diabetes care programs
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department of elementary and secondary education to promulgate rules and regulations implementing school diabetes care statutes.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Subjects diabetes care rules to chapter 536 administrative procedures and nonseverability requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 167.824 governing department rules for school diabetes care and administrative nonseverability.

headings.title: Definitions of recovery high schools and sponsoring entities
headings.reviewNote: Defines board, commissioner, recovery high school, sending district, and sponsoring entity for recovery school provisions.

headings.title: Commissioner authorization of pilot recovery high schools
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to approve up to four pilot recovery high schools statewide through requests for proposals.

headings.title: Student eligibility, admissions agreements, and nondiscrimination
headings.reviewNote: Establishes eligibility for students recovering from substance use disorders, authorizing enrollment agreements and barring discrimination.

headings.title: Tuition calculation rates, excess costs, and reciprocity
headings.reviewNote: Establishes tuition calculation rates paid by sending districts, state excess cost funding, and interstate reciprocity agreements.

headings.title: State board rules and administrative nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state board rulemaking in consultation with mental health department, subject to chapter 536 nonseverability.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 167.850 governing pilot recovery high schools for students with substance use disorders, funding, and rules.

headings.title: Department compilation of transfer student performance scores
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to compile and maintain student performance data scores for section 167.895 transfer students on the Missouri comprehensive data system without accessible personally identifiable data.

headings.title: Permissive department rulemaking and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to promulgate necessary administration rules subject to chapter 536 and section 536.028, with nonseverability for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2019.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 167.890 governing department compilation of transfer student performance data on the Missouri comprehensive data system and permissive rulemaking.

headings.title: Definitions of attendance centers and transfer districts
headings.reviewNote: Defines approved charter school, attendance center, available receiving district, receiving district, and sending district.

headings.title: Intradistrict transfers to accredited attendance centers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes students in unaccredited attendance centers to transfer within their home district, subject to capacity and reporting.

headings.title: Interdistrict transfers to accredited districts or charter schools
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transfers to accredited districts or approved charter schools in same or adjoining counties when resident capacity is lacking.

headings.title: Ineligibility of primary attendance centers through grade two
headings.reviewNote: Precludes students attending or entering attendance centers that do not offer classes above grade two from transfer eligibility.

headings.title: Ineligibility of provisionally accredited or unaccredited schools
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unaccredited or provisionally accredited districts and attendance centers from receiving transfer students.

headings.title: Waiver authorization for accredited attendance centers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department waivers allowing accredited attendance centers in provisionally accredited or unaccredited districts to accept transfers.

headings.title: Student rights upon classification change of receiving district
headings.reviewNote: Preserves transfer student eligibility to remain or transfer upon reclassification of receiving districts or loss of charter status.

headings.title: Protection against mandatory staff hiring or classroom construction
headings.reviewNote: Protects receiving districts from mandatory teacher hiring, classroom construction, or exceeding MSIP class size standards.

headings.title: Annual setting and publication of available transfer capacity
headings.reviewNote: Requires receiving boards to establish and publish available transfer slots annually by February first.

headings.title: Tuition rate policy and sending district payments
headings.reviewNote: Requires available receiving districts and charter schools to establish annual tuition rates paid by sending districts under section 167.132.

headings.title: Appeals to department upon denial of transfer application
headings.reviewNote: Grants students denied transfer by a receiving district a right to appeal to the department under chapter 536 (source text states 'within fifteen days after the decision of the department').

headings.title: Continuation of transfer enrollment following reclassification
headings.reviewNote: Permits transfer students to continue through graduation or middle school completion if the sending district regains accreditation.

headings.title: Sending district responsibility for excess special education costs
headings.reviewNote: Maintains sending district financial responsibility for special education excess costs and special school district contracts.

headings.title: Special school district services for transfer pupils
headings.reviewNote: Directs special school districts to continue providing special education services to transfer students across component districts.

headings.title: Metropolitan unaccredited district duties for special education
headings.reviewNote: Maintains unaccredited metropolitan district responsibility for special education services, transportation, and adjoining contracts.

headings.title: Receiving district exemption from transfer transportation duties
headings.reviewNote: Exempts non-special receiving districts from providing transportation to transfer students, authorizing unaccredited district contracts.

headings.title: Unaccredited district contracts with non-special receiving districts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes unaccredited seven-director or urban districts to contract with non-special receiving districts for special education services.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 17 subsection headings for 167.895 governing student transfers from unaccredited districts, receiving eligibility, tuition, and special education.

headings.title: Annual reporting of available transfer enrollment slots
headings.reviewNote: Requires accredited districts in the same or adjoining county, unaccredited districts for accredited-scoring schools, and eligible approved charter schools to report available enrollment slots by July 15, 2019 and January first annually.

headings.title: Department information and assistance for transferring parents
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to provide information and guidance to parents seeking student transfers to accredited districts or charter schools.

headings.title: March first deadline for student transfer notifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires parents to submit initial transfer notification to the department by March first preceding the enrollment school year.

headings.title: Department assignment factors, preferences, and exclusions
headings.reviewNote: Directs department assignment based on student choice, best interests, transportation, and sibling priorities, barring test score factors.

headings.title: Transfer denials for violence or disciplinary suspensions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transfer denials for students suspended for school violence, allows provisional transfers, and mandates behavior rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 167.898 governing transfer application timelines, department student assignments, and disruptive behavior bars.

headings.title: Identification of critical need occupations and career data
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department of economic development annually to identify critical-need occupations and requires the state board of education, in collaboration with it, to compile ten categories of career, credential, salary, financial aid, and job-search information.

headings.title: Distribution of workforce need materials to high schools
headings.reviewNote: Requires the state board to distribute the compiled materials to each high school and requires each high school to provide the information to students before November first every school year.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 167.902 governing critical need occupation identification, career data compilation, and annual distribution to high school students.

headings.title: Development and review of personal plan of study
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes students to develop personal plans of study with counselors before ninth grade, detailing goals, courses, and graduation terms.

headings.title: District policy for personal plan waivers under IEPs
headings.reviewNote: Requires school districts to adopt policies permitting waiver of personal plan requirements for disabled students upon IEP recommendation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 167.903 governing personal plans of study for secondary students and disability waiver policies.

headings.title: District system for identifying ninth-grade at-risk students
headings.reviewNote: Requires school districts to implement identification systems evaluating assessment performance, remediation rates, and attendance.

headings.title: Mandatory academic and career counseling before graduation
headings.reviewNote: Requires district policies to mandate academic and career counseling prior to graduation to ensure students graduate college and career-ready.

headings.title: Waiver policy for students with disabilities under IEPs
headings.reviewNote: Directs school districts to adopt policies allowing waiver of career identification requirements for disabled students under IEPs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 167.905 governing identification of ninth-grade students at risk of career or college unreadiness.

headings.title: Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act aid application procedures
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department of higher education and workforce development by rule to establish procedures for career and technical education students under section 170.029 to apply for federal Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act aid.

headings.title: Phased implementation percentage benchmarks for area career centers
headings.reviewNote: Establishes annual phased percentage targets requiring all area career centers to provide workforce aid application capability by 2025-26.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 167.908 governing Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act aid applications for career center students.

headings.title: Department dyslexia screening guidelines and classroom support
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to develop dyslexia screening guidelines and requires public and charter schools to conduct annual screenings and support.

headings.title: Mandatory teacher in-service training on dyslexia disorders
headings.reviewNote: Requires school districts and charter schools to provide two hours of annual in-service training on dyslexia for all practicing teachers.

headings.title: Statutory definitions of dyslexia, screening, and support
headings.reviewNote: Defines dyslexia, dyslexia screening, related disorders, and support, clarifying that the dyslexia definition does not require an IEP unless federal conditions are otherwise met.

headings.title: State board rules and administrative nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Directs state board of education to promulgate screening rules subject to chapter 536 administrative procedures and nonseverability.

headings.title: Limitation on MO HealthNet service expansion
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory dyslexia screening and classroom support provisions do not require expanding MO HealthNet program services.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 167.950 governing student dyslexia screening guidelines, teacher in-service training, and definitions.
